description: This file defines the Cookies class used for managing browser cookies via JavaScript interop in a Blazor application.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A helper class to facilitate getting and deleting cookies in a Blazor application through JavaScript interop.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Deletes a specified cookie by name using JavaScript interop.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified cookie by name via JavaScript interop.
